faqs.question: Do you have different furniture designs and styles?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer a variety of designs, colours, fabrics, sizes, and styles to suit different preferences and home interiors.

faqs.question: Can I see a product before purchasing it?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can visit our showroom to view and inspect available products before making your purchase.

faqs.question: Can I choose my own fabric and colour?
faqs.answer: Yes, for products that support customization. You can select from the available fabric, leather, colour, and material options. faqs.question: What happens after I place an order?
faqs.answer: After placing your order: 1. You receive an order confirmation. 2. Our team may contact you to confirm the order and customization details. 3. For customized products, production begins after the specifications are finalized. 4. The furniture is manufactured/prepared. 5. The order is dispatched. 6. Our delivery team coordinates delivery with you. 7. Installation is completed where applicable.

faqs.question: How can I place an order on the Furniture Bazaar website?
faqs.answer: Choose your furniture, select the available options such as size, fabric, colour, and configuration, and click “Add to Cart” or “Buy Now.” Enter your delivery details, select your payment method, and complete the order.

faqs.question: Can I place an order through WhatsApp or by phone?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can contact our team through WhatsApp or phone for assistance with product selection, customization, quotations, and orders. For customized furniture, our team may confirm all specifications with you before the order is sent for production.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept the payment methods available through our online payment gateway, which may include: UPI, Credit cards, Debit cards, Net banking, Wallets, and EMI or other payment options, where available.

faqs.question: Is online payment secure?
faqs.answer: Yes. Online payments are processed through our authorized payment gateway using secure payment infrastructure. Furniture Bazaar will never ask you to share your OTP, PIN, CVV, password, or banking credentials with our staff.

faqs.question: Can I pay a partial amount or advance for customized furniture?
faqs.answer: For selected customized or made-to-order furniture, an advance or booking payment may be available. The required advance amount and balance-payment schedule will be communicated before the order is confirmed.

faqs.question: Will I receive an order confirmation after payment?
faqs.answer: Yes. After a successful order, you will receive an order confirmation through the contact details provided during checkout. For customized furniture, our team may contact you to confirm the final specifications before production begins.

faqs.question: What happens if my payment is successful but I don't receive an order confirmation?
faqs.answer: Please do not make another payment immediately. Contact our customer-support team with your payment reference/transaction details. We will verify the transaction and confirm your order status.

faqs.question: Can I change my order after placing it?
faqs.answer: Changes may be possible if the order has not entered production or processing. For customized furniture, changes to dimensions, fabric, colour, configuration, or other specifications may not be possible once manufacturing has started. Please contact us as soon as possible if you need to make a change.
search_variations: can I change sofa colour after ordering

faqs.question: Can I cancel my order after making the payment?
faqs.answer: Cancellation depends on the type and stage of your order. Standard orders may be eligible for cancellation before processing, manufacturing, or dispatch. Customized or made-to-order furniture generally cannot be cancelled once production has started, subject to our Cancellation & Refund Policy and applicable law.
search_variations: how do I cancel my order

faqs.question: Will I receive an invoice for my purchase?
faqs.answer: Yes. An invoice will be provided for your purchase with the applicable product, pricing, tax, and order details. For GST-registered customers, please provide the required billing information and GSTIN during the ordering process where applicable.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Delivery time depends on product availability, order type, and delivery location. The estimated delivery timeline will be communicated when your order is confirmed.

faqs.question: Do you provide home delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes, home delivery is available in selected locations. Availability and delivery charges may vary depending on the location.

faqs.question: Is home delivery free?
faqs.answer: Free delivery may be available for selected locations or under specific offers. Delivery charges, if applicable, will be communicated before confirming the order.

faqs.question: Do you deliver to my location?

faqs.question: What should I do if my furniture arrives damaged?
faqs.answer: Please inform our delivery team or customer-care team immediately and provide photographs or videos of the damage, if required.

faqs.question: Do you provide furniture installation services?
faqs.answer: Installation or assembly services may be available for selected products.

faqs.question: Is installation free of charge?

faqs.question: Who will assemble my bed or wardrobe?

faqs.question: Do you deliver furniture to upper floors?

faqs.question: What materials are used in your furniture?
faqs.answer: The materials used vary depending on the product and model. Specific material details can be confirmed before purchase.

faqs.question: Is your furniture durable?
faqs.answer: We focus on providing quality furniture, while durability also depends on the product, usage, care, and maintenance.

faqs.question: Do you provide a warranty?
faqs.answer: Warranty coverage may be available on selected products. The warranty period and coverage vary depending on the product.

faqs.question: What does the warranty cover?
faqs.answer: Warranty coverage is product-specific and may cover manufacturing defects or specified components, subject to the applicable warranty terms.

faqs.question: Does the warranty cover accidental damage?
faqs.answer: Accidental damage is generally not covered under standard warranty terms. Please check the specific warranty conditions for your product.

faqs.question: How should I maintain my furniture?
faqs.answer: Follow the recommended cleaning and maintenance instructions for your specific furniture material and avoid using harsh chemicals.
